title: 106th Rescue Wing December Team Rescue TV
description: The 106th Rescue Wing produces its monthly news broadcast Team Rescue TV at Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., December 6, 2024. Team Rescue TV is the 106th's monthly news broadcast that informs the Wing on events and training conducted throughout each month. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Captain Cheran Campbell, Technical Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Technical Sgt. Sean Madden, Technical Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, and Senior Airman Sarah McKernan)

Swedish personnel with an opportunity

and rescue capabilities of the 106 and
to allow key leaders and airmen from

get to know each other . The visit also
included members from the Vermont Air
National Guard's 158th Fighter Wing .

capabilities . And 4 other members of

National Guard participated in the
winter training planners course from
November 25th to the 29th at the

Center in Bolden , Sweden . The

planning training exercises in
subarctic and Arctic environments . The
guardsmen practiced evaluating the
terrain , frozen waterways , and
marshlands to ensure safe navigation .
This collaboration strengthens the
state partnership program between the
New York National Guard and Sweden ,
enhancing our ability to operate in
extreme environments and fostering
international cooperation .
